character.name: Idle
character.prompt: A fierce, evil, strong-looking, punk-goth witch standing in a aggressive combat stance. She has a sinister smile with sharp, long, wolf-like canine  fangs.  She has wild, long, spiky purple hair that fades into neon green halfway down her head, pointed gray wolf-like ears, glowing purple eyes.  She is wearing a black leather top, a tattered asymmetrical black skirt adorned with chains, belts, bone accessories, and along with heavy black leather combat boots. She has tattoos on her arms.   A black raven with glowing green eyes is perched on her right shoulder. In one of the punk-goth witch's hand, she wields a long gnarled wooden staff decorated with hanging bone charms. At the top tip of the staff is a large, stylized magical flame in bright purple and blue.  She has long claw-like finger nails that are visible in her empty hand.  In the style of rick and morty mixed with the style of adventure time
